steps.text: Hi, you've reached {{bank_name}}. I'm the bank's AI specialist, and this call is recorded.
Hi Olivia, how can I help you today?
Hi, I'm just after my balance, thanks. I'm about to pay a tradie and want to make sure there's enough in there.

steps.summary: Olivia wants her balance before making a payment.

steps.text: Easy done. I've sent a notification to your banking app, so just tap Approve for me.
Thanks Olivia. One moment, I'm just checking that for you.
Your Everyday account has ${{get_customer_overview.accounts.0.available_balance|a healthy balance}} available right now.
Great. And has everything gone through from the last few days? Nothing stuck?
One moment, I'll check your recent transactions.
I've looked through the last four days and your card purchases have gone through normally. I can't see anything on hold.
Perfect, that's all I needed. Thanks!

steps.summary: Balance and recent transactions confirmed. Nothing further needed.

steps.text: No worries, Olivia. Have a lovely day.
